summary.text: Ross Ford is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 76 since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Ross Ford took office on November 28, 2017, succeeding David Brumbaugh.
Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignments as the Appropriations and Budget Committee and the Judiciary and Public Safety Oversight Committee.
Michael Tinsley, a Democrat, is his opponent in the November 3, 2026 general election.
